notes.title: Arena Master (VR) update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26891905/c818315ee78ae68a7851cea91de8bd36030b11b2.jpg[/img]

[h1]v0.9.0.4 patch notes:[/h1]
- Arena Master is using the latest Unreal Engine version, which brings around 25% better performance in VR
- Force feedback effects are added on weapon hit
- Weapon collision is removed, shield and sword can now freely overlap each other
- First few enemy waves are now harder
- Enemy characters are no longer stuck sometimes
- Game now properly closes when exited from Steam (overlay) menu

tags.feature: - Force feedback effects are added on weapon hit

tags.balance_change: - First few enemy waves are now harder

tags.bug: - Enemy characters are no longer stuck sometimes
- Game now properly closes when exited from Steam (overlay) menu
